title: Widgets and controls · 0.6.2
description: Start a chat or talk to Lumen from your Home Screen, Lock Screen, Control Center or Action button.
notes: Home Screen widget: tap it for a new chat, or tap its microphone to start talking. The medium size has an “Ask anything” box.
Lock Screen widgets open a new Lumen chat in one tap.
Control Center: add “New Lumen Chat” or “Talk to Lumen”. You can also put them on the Lock Screen or the Action button.
Also new in 0.6: voice input, Read aloud, Siri and Shortcuts, and replies that finish (with a notification) after you leave Lumen.
